scope: Native Pod termination grace, force shortening, UID reuse and restart recovery
stateNote: Reused this owned, stopped disposable cluster and its image cache; five new test Pod UIDs are indexed in pod-log-index.json. Containerd log includes preceding runs. No production state was used.

localValidation.kubectl: Strict Pod grace admission, spec patch generation increment, absence of false observedGeneration with disabled agent, and deletion passed against this native binary

behavior: Default spec.terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 30; deleting metadata persists an absolute deadline and grace override.
Repeated deletes preserve the original deadline or shorten it relative to the original deletion start; explicit zero withdraws the assignment immediately.
Native CRI StopContainer requests run concurrently against one deadline; cancelling an old transport allows force-shortening without blocking reconciliation.
Control plane retains gracefully deleting Pods until the agent reports Deleted for the exact UID and resourceVersion.
Agent retains final Deleted acknowledgements while assignments remain; handshake replay reconstructs acknowledgements lost across an agent restart.
A replacement Pod UID cannot overwrite the old UID recovery record before cleanup completes.
Create resets client generation to 1; supported spec updates and first deletion increment it; metadata-only updates do not. observedGeneration requires an actual matching observation.
Shutdown grace is excluded from the workload fingerprint, so defaulting or changing it does not restart running containers.

precedingRuns.classification: Harness conflated process exit with sandbox/API cleanup, then hit a cleanup KeyError. Native logs show SIGTERM handler exit after two seconds. Raw report and investigation preserved; orphan native process was manually stopped, exit code unrecorded.
Harness assumed one shim per container; corrected to identify uniquely tagged actual shell processes. Clean finalizer and zero owned shims.
All four native scenarios passed before final reconnect-replay fix; repeated against final source above.

harnessNote: After the final run, log artifact filenames were changed to include UID and a Pod inventory was added to the harness, preventing same-name replacements from overwriting earlier container logs. All six final-run logs were independently recovered by UID and preserved alongside the unchanged raw report. The first standalone kubectl harness incorrectly expected observedGeneration with the agent disabled; corrected verification requires its absence and passed without changing runtime code.
remainingWork: This supplemental native validation does not establish complete upstream Kubernetes conformance. Latest completed full baseline was 19 passed/427 failed of 446; later full runs are still in progress.
Pod conditions/readiness, probes, init containers and lifecycle hooks remain separate gaps.
Podman CLI output/error and cancellation paths are covered locally; live optional Podman integration was skipped.
